Read and agree to consent statement It is necessary for you to supply us with personal data in connection with the Olam sustainability programme of which you are part of. This personal data will be collected and stored on the Olam Farmer Information System ("OFIS"). You may subsequently withdraw any consent given for our collection, use and disclosure of your personal data. However, failure to supply your personal data and/or subsequent withdrawal of your consent may result in you being unable to participate in the sustainability programme.
Your personal data will be used on the OFIS to help populate information on:
The mapping software. This is designed to showcase the farm and infrastructure locations and provide more detailed information about Farmers linked to their geographical location.
Analysis software. This looks at a Farmer\'s personal data against aggregate data in order to help determine the future direction of the programme. OFIS users are able to export the analysis (and data behind the analysis, such as a Farmer\'s personal data) into either a PDF or excel spreadsheet. This export function allows users to identify specific Farmers, with, for example, the highest or lowest productivity levels in the programme.
Farm Management Plans. These will be tailor made plans for individual Farmers highlighting the changes needed to be made on the farm over 3-5 years in order to reach the full productivity potential.
OFIS users include employees of Olam, farmer group management staff and customers worldwide, in accordance with the mapping software, analysis software and farm management plans in paragraph 2 above.
Your personal data which is held by us will be kept confidential, but it will be shared with OFIS users as highlighted above. Your personal data may be transferred to a place outside your local jurisdiction. Where we do so, subject to applicable privacy law, we will take steps to ensure that the standard of protection accorded to your transferred personal data is comparable to the protection under the applicable privacy law in your local jurisdiction.
You may withdraw any consent given, request for access and/or correction of your personal data and/or request for information regarding our policies and practices, by contacting our Data Protection Officer through ofis@olamnet.com.

FARMER CONSENT Personal Information Collection Notice 1. Personal Data Use We may use and share your personal data as follows Do you consent? Please tick “✔ “ or “yes” Populating ofi-related Systems We may collect Farmer Data to populate ofi related systems where your data can be organized and then analysed to give us important insights such as trends and issues that affect the supply chain as well as improve our services to you and our customers. In order to do so, employees of ofi and its affiliates and certain 3rd-party processors will have access to such ofi-related Systems and your Farmer Data. Your Farmer Data may be shared with our affiliates, partners, and customers. Providing Traceability to the Market We may share the Farmer Data you provide us with our customers and partners (who may also share the Farmer Data with their customers and partners) in order to provide insights into where their food is sourced and who is producing it. This transparency allows buyers to make informed and responsible purchasing decisions. These traceability efforts will be shared with the public. Trend and Issue Spotting ----- Farmer Sales and Development We may use your Farmer Data to do business with you and to help identify opportunities for you to grow your business and operations. When appropriate, we may present you with opportunities to obtain financing, machinery, farm management advice, farm supplies, and insurance, in addition to sales opportunities - all of which will be provided directly by us or a third-party that we refer to you. Accordingly, these third parties will be provided access to your Farmer Data in order to provide these sales and development opportunities to you. Promoting Traceability ------ Public Advertising and Promotion Ofi and its affiliates, which, for the avoidance of doubt, includes including Olam Brands B.V. and ofi customers and partners may use Farmer Data including names, photographs, location information, product information and interviews (if provided) in advertising materials that will be shared publicly, such as on websites, written publications and on products in order to promote purchases of products such as those produced by you and to market our traceability and sustainability initiatives. Research We may share your Farmer Data in support of studies by educational, governmental, and non-governmental organisations focused on local farmers, communities, agriculture, supply-chain, traceability, sustainability and related socially conscious studies in order to promote community collaboration and developments in the sustainability and traceability space. Such organisations may use your Farmer Data in their own electronic or published communications. 2. When your Farmer Data is shared with third parties such as our customers and partners in furtherance of the Purpose and the specific uses consented to above, each of these customers and partners are data controllers in their own right and you consent to their use of your data as set forth above in Paragraph 1 and as detailed in the Privacy Statement. Should any of such customers and partners require use of your Farmer Data beyond the Purpose and specific uses consented to above, they may directly contact you to request for your further consent. 3. You may withdraw consent given, request for access and/or correction of your Farmer Data and/or request for information regarding our policies and practices at any time by contacting us at privacy@ofi.com. While no disclosure requested is obligatory, failure to supply your Farmer Data and/or subsequent withdrawal of your consent may affect our ability to provide certain services that you may have separately requested from us (as the case may be). For example, your address may be required not only to assist with traceability, but also for us to deliver certain materials to you such as farming supplies. In such instances where you revoke consent, we may retain such data in order to fulfil our contractual obligations to you but will not use such data for any other purpose. 4. Our Farmer Data Privacy Statement is provided for your reference below. It explains how we handle and protect personal data. While your Farmer Data will be shared with the persons indicated above, your Farmer Data that is held by us will be kept confidential and in accordance with applicable privacy laws. " "• Where I am consenting on behalf of a child or minor, I am either the parent or legal guardian of the child or minor. I understand that I will not be receiving any financial or other remuneration for any personal data including any images and any intellectual property which subsists in any image shall belong to ofi. Farmer Data Privacy Statement This privacy policy sets forth the modes of collection, utilisation and disclosure of your information gathered on the application. It is supplemental to, and should be read together with the ofi’s Privacy Statement, which explains additional ways we collect and use personal data and is available on www.ofi.com/privacy.html. What data do we collect? We may collect and process personal data about you including but not limited to:\n • Photographs, videos and other imaging (where your personal identity is clearly identifiable);\n • First name and last name; \n • Farming data including output and infrastructure;\n • Feedback from you;\n • Social, financial, geographical and biographical information;\n • Address and other contact details.\n • Location data upon your allowing us access to your location in the application
For what purposes do we use your data? "We may use this data for the following purposes: \n • Provide services to you such as agronomy advice, farming materials and access to farming related services such as financing, insurance, and logistics;\n • Facilitate trading with you; \n • Publication on ofi owned channels including websites, social media and prints; \n • Support our sustainability and traceability initiatives; \n • Identify trends in agriculture that will allow us to better operate our business and provide services to you; \n • Market and promote ofi products and corporate activities; \n • Support research initiatives by our partners to support community collaboration and advancements in the sustainability and traceability areas; \n • Demonstrate our farmer services to potential investors and partners; and \n • Communicate with you and develop and manage our relationships with you and our business partners. " What is our legal basis for collecting and processing your data? We will only collect and process this data, to conduct our business and pursue our legitimate interests as required by ofi and our affiliates and to comply with legal obligations. We rely on consent for few processing activities (like marketing communication) which can be revoked whenever the data subject requires. Who will we share this data with? We may share your data with other members of the ofi group, including any affiliates, to achieve the purposes described above. We will also share your data with government authorities and/or law enforcement officials if mandated by law, and any current and future customers, service providers, suppliers and business partners of ofi in pursuing the purposes described above or otherwise with your consent. Where will we send your data? Other than sharing with our third-party processors for the purposes listed above, from time to time your data may be transferred to one of our affiliates in another country. We will take reasonable steps to ensure that your data is adequately protected in accordance with the relevant data protection legislation which resides over processing of data in that country. If you are a farmer based in the EEA, where your personal information is transferred outside the EEA to an affiliate or an entity in a country that is not subject to an adequacy decision by the EU Commission, your personal data will be protected by EU Commission approved cross-border safeguards including standard contractual clauses for cross-border data transfer. What measures do we have in place to protect your data? Ofi maintains reasonable safeguards to protect the confidentiality, security and integrity of your data. Although we use security measures to help protect your data against unauthorized disclosure, we cannot guarantee the security of information provided over the internet and will not be responsible for breaches of security beyond our reasonable control. What rights do you have in relation to your data? You may choose not to provide data that we request. You have the right to ask ofi for a copy of your data and to verify, correct or restrict active processing of your data. You can ask ofi to stop using your images at any time, in which case it will not be used in future publications but may continue to appear in publications already in circulation. You have the right to make a complaint at any time to the data protection authority in concerned region. These rights may be limited in law. If you wish to exercise these rights or have any questions about them, you can contact ofi at privacy@ofi.com. How long will you retain my data? Except as otherwise required by law, ofi will retain your personal data for such period that is necessary for the purposes for which the data was collected. Ofi will share the retention period of your personal data upon your request. Contact Details If you have any questions relating to the data we hold about you then please email us at privacy@ofi.com.

Olam Food Ingredients and our affiliates worldwide (collectively, “ofi,” “we,” “us,” “our”) understand the importance of privacy to you. This Privacy Statement summarizes what personal information we may collect, how we may use this information, and other important topics relating to your privacy and data protection.\n \n It is ofi’s policy to comply with all applicable privacy and data protection laws. This commitment reflects the value we place on earning and keeping the trust of our customers, business partners and others who share their personal information with us.\n \n This Privacy Statement applies to all websites and mobile applications (“apps”) operated by or on behalf of ofi. It also applies to personal information ofi may otherwise collect: (i) through our products and services; (ii) when you interact with us by means other than an ofi website or app, for example, in person, by telephone, or at a trade show or training; and (iii) from our customers, distributors, suppliers, vendors, and other business partners (collectively “Business Partners”).\n\n However, different ofi websites, apps, products, and services have different purposes and features. If additional or different disclosures are required for a specific ofi website, app, product, or service, then we provide those disclosures (“Specific Privacy Statements”) separately on, or with, the relevant website, app, product, or service. Each such specific privacy disclosure, policy, or statement supplements and amends this Privacy Statement.\n\n
General Principles of ofi’s Collection, Use and Disclosure of Personal Information In this Privacy Statement, “personal data” or “personal information” shall mean any information about an individual who can be identified from that information or from that information combined with other information to which we are likely to have access, including without limitation, information such as name, address, telephone number, email address, identification numbers, location data, and online identifiers.\n\n Additionally, “process” or “processing” means any operation which is performed upon personal information, whether or not by automatic means, such as collection, recording, organisation, structuring, storage, adaptation or alteration, retrieval, consultation, acquisition, holding, use, disclosure by transmission, dissemination or otherwise making available, alignment or combination, restriction, erasure, or destruction.\n\n To the extent required by applicable law, wherever ofi collects personal information, ofi will:\n\n • provide notice to you about our data practices;\n\n • collect your personal information only for the specified and legitimate purposes. The information we collect will be relevant, adequate, and not excessive for the purposes for which it is collected;\n\n • process your personal information in a manner consistent with the purposes for which it was collected or to which you consented;\n\n • take reasonable steps to ensure that your personal information is reliable for its intended use, accurate, complete, and, where necessary, kept up to date; and\n\n • take appropriate measures, by contract or otherwise, to provide adequate protection for personal information that is disclosed to a third party or transferred to another country, including transfers within ofi.\n\n You have choices about the personal information you provide to ofi. You may choose not to provide information that we request, but if you do so, we may not be able to provide you a relevant service or a particular feature for an ofi website, app, or product.
Personal Information ofi Collects ofi collects the following types of personal information -\n\n Information You Provide:\n\n • contact information, such as your name, company name, job title, address, email address, and phone number;\n\n • additional information about you to help us get to know you better, such as your gender, age, date of birth, nationality, marital status, details of dependents, employment history, professional associations and registration numbers, information about how you use our products, and demographic information;\n\n • financial information needed to process sales and purchases, such as credit card or account information or tax identification numbers;\n\n • log-in information, including, if applicable, social media account information for login purposes;\n\n • comments, questions, opinions, requests and orders or sales you may make; and\n\n • as applicable to our farmers and suppliers, information such as the geolocation of farms or businesses, product yields and related analytical information regarding farms or businesses such as inventories and farming methods, financial data such as financing information, pricing, wages, and farmer/supplier identification information such as photographs, signatures, and certificates verifying identity and education.\n\n Information from Business Partners and other Third Parties:\n\n • ofi collects personal information through our Business Partners. This information may include contact information, such as name, company name, job title, address, email address, phone number, education, purchase and sale information.\n\n • ofi also obtains personal information from other third-party sources, including publicly and commercially available sources.\n\n Information Automatically Gathered from Your Device:\n\n • ofi collects technical information about your device, such as device and advertising identifiers, browser type, pages you view and the general manner while navigating the site, location data, Internet Protocol (“IP”) address, operating system, date and time of your visit and certain server logs for system administration purposes. ofi collects this information automatically from your device and web browser through cookies and similar technologies.
Cookies and Similar Technologies A "cookie" is a file of information placed on your device when you visit a website. Cookies and similar technologies can enhance your user experience by saving your preferences and personalising your online experience.\n\n Certain jurisdictions require that your consent is provided before the use of certain cookies when you visit ofi websites. If you access an ofi website from one of these countries, you will be presented with information regarding your options via a cookie consent banner, including the option to accept or reject such cookies. You will be able to change such settings on the cookie consent banner.There are certain cookies which are strictly necessary to the performance of our website which cannot be rejected.\n\n Please refer to our Cookie Policy for more information here
How OFI Uses Your Personal Information ofi uses your personal information to:\n\n Develop and manage our relationships with you and our Business Partners. This includes: (i) delivering services or carrying out transactions that you have requested; (ii) providing information about ofi products, services, transactions, and advertisements, that may be of interest to you; (iii) providing you a more consistent experience in interacting with ofi, including by learning more about you and how you use and interact with ofi websites, apps, products, and services; (iv) planning, managing, and performing under our contractual relationships with you; (v) providing after-sales support to you; and (vi) in the case of farmers, providing farm-management plans and enhancing farming capabilities.\n\n Provide Traceability in the Supply Chain. ofi is committed to empowering our customers and producers by providing traceability in the supply chain. Traceability allows for socially and environmentally responsible sourcing in the supply chain of our products. Accordingly, we use farmer and supplier personal information to enhance traceability and strengthen our partnerships with our farmers, suppliers, and buyers while improving our traceability-focused websites and apps and empowering our Business Partners and affiliates to make informed and responsible sourcing decisions.\n\n Foster Careers. You may submit your resume and other information to apply for a job with us either through our sites or via email to an official ofi email address. We use the information you submit solely for the purposes of considering applications and recruitment (and for purposes of our administration or management if you commence work for us), and not to market to you.\n\n Communicate with you. This includes: (i) informing you of ofi products, services, events and promotional activities that you requested or may be of interest to you; (ii) providing information about relevant ofi products, services, and transactions, including, for example, pricing information, technical data, invoice, shipping, or production information, warranty or recall information, or information about product or service improvements; (iii) responding to questions or inquiries that you make, including customer service requests; and (iv) inviting you to participate in, or informing you of the results of, customer satisfaction or market research surveys.\n\n Provide and improve our websites, apps, products, and services. This includes: (i) customizing them to your preferences or interests, making them more compatible with your technology, or otherwise making them easier to use; (ii) maintaining the security of and otherwise protecting them; and (iii) and developing new websites, apps, products and services.\n\n Address legal issues.
